items.title: George Wein — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He came out of Island Pond, Vermont, the hometown of Rudy Vallee.

ctx.x: Since we're talking about Charlie, let's talk just a little bit more about promotion before we take a break. Was Charlie, back then, a publicist already? He was a kid like you, really, right? Just doing what he loved to do?

Absolutely. He came out of Island Pond, Vermont, the hometown of Rudy Vallee. I think Charlie was concerned with getting away from Island Pond, Vermont, in those days. The last few years, he went back there to check it out. But he didn't want to be from Island Pond, he wanted to be from Harvard Square, Cambridge. He wanted that quality that life gave you that a lot of people love and a lot of people hate. A lot of Republicans hate it very much. They run the country, you know, they don't like that – Harvard Square…
But he was sort of operating on his own to your benefit.
